note: Copy of thresholds.json with the served-model scores removed, for runs of models that are not served on Orion, so their reports carry no served-model comparison. Each pass mark is the weakest served model's score plus (lower is better) or minus (higher is better) sqrt(2) times the distance to the edge of its 95% Wilson interval; en_integrity's 0.95 is fixed from hand labels. min_scored (100) and max_excluded_fraction (0.10: the share of a case's prompts that may be excluded as failed or empty before the case is insufficient_data) are proposals. The integrity cases' line_rule and share_threshold come from hand labels and a sensitivity grid; min_thai_ratio, min_line_letters and foreign_letter_share are not tuned beyond that grid.
